# Unified variable evaluation verification

Issue: #470. Implementation branch: `feature/v4-unified-variable-evaluation`.

## Contract and integration

The default policy is `reuse`: an explicitly immutable evaluation owns derived values shared by forcing, nonlinear dynamics, passive consumers and output plans. New RK stages and independently initiated calls start new evaluations. State identity includes owner, times and coefficient shapes/storage, with an explicit caller obligation to keep borrowed coefficients immutable while a scope is active. Equal time or storage addresses alone never start a cache hit across scopes.

`execution.variableEvaluationPolicy` accepts `reuse` and `low-memory` in run-request v2; omission selects `reuse`. C++ callers can select the same enum through model setup/services. Cache policy and cache values are not checkpoint state. Low-memory eviction is explicit and recorded; pinned values cannot be evicted. Invalid policy and allocation failure are errors, with no silent policy fallback.

Canonical portable-variable contracts remain authoritative. Runtime execution keys distinguish physical fields, components, derivatives, reductions, phase, forcing stage/prefix and sampling geometry. Natural-grid fields are shared independently of output geometry. State mutation through an owned constraint operation is forbidden inside an immutable scope.

## Performance fixture

An exact compact copy of the completed EddyTide day-1200 state was prepared at `/private/tmp/wvm-unified-evaluation-qualification/eddytide-day1200.nc`. The qualified #469 baseline initialized the output schema, and the final scientific record was copied without integration. Static variables and coefficient bytes were compared to the original; the source file size and modification timestamp were unchanged. The receipt is `/private/tmp/wvm-unified-evaluation-qualification/fixture-receipt.json`.

The production file is read-only input, not a benchmark destination. No performance claim has been made while other experiment work is active. Final qualification requires frozen baseline/candidate source and binary hashes, two warmup and eight alternating measured pairs, exact output/control comparison, elapsed-runtime analysis and retained/peak memory for both policies. The low-memory 3% limit applies to maximum live owned storage. Retained capacity is reported separately because moving invocation-local allocations into preparation changes their lifetime without adding a simultaneous scientific volume; the total ledger must not count prepared capacity twice. The EddyTide-sized case and existing representative 256-grid composite fixtures must be included.

The first EddyTide smoke continuation completed twelve accepted RK78 steps, zero rejected steps and 156 RHS evaluations under both policies. Actual producers each validated/prepared phase/reconstructed each requested field or derivative 156 times. The candidate's ledger reported zero duplicates. Exact output comparison failed; a controlled repeat of the **same frozen baseline executable** also differed, by at most `6.90e-18` in scientific coefficients. Integration decisions were identical. [The baseline repeatability receipt](../ci-evidence/issue-470-variable-evaluation/baseline-repeatability.json) records the evidence. Final EddyTide comparison therefore uses the existing native/MATLAB scientific tolerances (`rtol=1e-10`, `atol=1e-12`), reports whether results are bitwise equal, and preserves exact metadata, integration configuration and accepted/rejected-step decisions. Error-estimator diagnostic differences are reported separately. Smoke timings are excluded from performance qualification.

The subsequent correctness/storage smoke used a frozen copy of the development executable against fresh copies of all three fixtures, without a timing claim. All six baseline/candidate scientific comparisons passed. Low-memory maximum-live owned-storage ratios were 1.000262 (EddyTide), 1.006184 (large constant stratification), and 1.000065 (large variable Hydrostatic), all within the 3% target. Default reuse retained more shared volumes on the two larger cases (peak ratios 1.165473 and 1.100524); this trade-off will be reported with final timings. The raw development receipt is `/private/tmp/wvm470-storage-smoke-v2/summary.json`. These results do not replace the frozen-source, idle-host performance campaign.

## Remaining gates

All-family integration and actual-producer audits; compound diagnostic dependencies and density-reference isolation; allocation/memory accounting; full focused Release/sanitizer batch; exact-source MATLAB parity and lifecycle receipts; idle-host performance qualification; required hosted checks and reviewed integration against #469. Issue #470 and the coordinated goal remain open until these gates are complete.
